A '''Yuuzhan Vong shaper''' was present in [[27 ABY/Legends|27 ABY]] on the [[Koros-Strohna|worldship]] ''[[Baanu Rass]]''. She was slain by the [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Lomi Plo]] after the latter managed to regain her [[The Force/Legends|Force]] powers after the [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamiri]] in the room they were in were killed.
